summary: Frontend validation of SB Student Marketplace buyer↔seller messaging (test2@example.com). All selectors present and conversation persistence works end-to-end (sent message visible in Inbox, conv labeled 'Nina Vendeuse · CHAT Manuel anglais', re-open shows history, right-aligned bubble for buyer). CRITICAL BUG FOUND: clicking the chat 'send' button (both empty and non-empty) closes the ChatSheet AND its parent sheet (DetailSheet when opened from listing detail; InboxSheet when opened from inbox). Root cause: ChatSheet renders as a child of DetailSheet/InboxSheet overlay divs which have onClick={onClose}; clicks inside ChatSheet bubble up. The first send still persists on backend (the conv was created and msg saved) but the user is bounced back to the marketplace listings instead of staying in the chat — making it impossible to send a second message in the same session without re-opening the chat. Empty-send is supposed to be a no-op but also closes everything.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Clicking mkt-chat-send (empty OR non-empty) closes the ChatSheet AND the parent DetailSheet/InboxSheet. Reproduced 100% in both paths (listing→Contacter le vendeur→send AND inbox→conv→send). The ChatSheet root <div className='fixed inset-0 z-50 ...'> is rendered as a sibling of DetailSheet/InboxSheet's inner content div, so click events bubble up to the parent overlay's onClick={onClose}. Fix: add onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} on the ChatSheet root div OR render ChatSheet via a portal outside DetailSheet/InboxSheet.
Empty-send still triggers the click bubble even though send() returns early. Either stopPropagation in the button's onClick wrapper, or attach onClick stopPropagation on the chat root.

integration_issues.issue: Conversation IS created server-side and message IS persisted (verified via Inbox listing showing 'Nina Vendeuse · CHAT Manuel anglais\n\nBonjour, hello-AAA-real'). But the user is unexpectedly returned to the marketplace listings page right after pressing send, so they can't continue chatting in the same session.

issues: The VerifyEmailBanner (z-[60]) still covers the bottom of the DetailSheet and can occlude the 'Contacter le vendeur' button on mobile; workaround in tests was to dismiss via [data-testid='verify-email-banner-dismiss'] then scroll_into_view_if_needed before click.

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): Stop click propagation on ChatSheet root in /app/frontend/src/pages/user/SbMarketplacePage.js line 602. Suggested change: <div className='fixed inset-0 z-50 flex flex-col bg-white' onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} data-testid='mkt-chat-sheet'>. This single change fixes both the listing-detail path AND the inbox path because both parents (DetailSheet line 200, InboxSheet line 528) use onClick={onClose} on their outer overlay div.

ALTERNATIVE FIX: Move <ChatSheet ...> out of DetailSheet/InboxSheet and render it at the page level so it isn't a child of any onClose-overlay. Currently ChatSheet is mounted at SbMarketplacePage line 255 (inside DetailSheet) and likely also via InboxSheet's setActive flow.

Verify after fix: (a) after sending a real message, ChatSheet stays open and shows the bubble; (b) clicking send with empty input is a true no-op (chat & detail/inbox remain open); (c) 500-char limit and scroll-to-latest behave correctly (could not be fully tested in this iteration due to the bug).
critical_code_review_comments: SbMarketplacePage.js line 200: DetailSheet outer div has onClick={onClose} as a tap-outside-to-close affordance, but it captures click events bubbled from ChatSheet (line 255) which is rendered as a sibling of the inner content div (line 201). The inner content div stops propagation but ChatSheet does not, leading to inadvertent close.
SbMarketplacePage.js line 528: Same pattern in InboxSheet — outer overlay onClick={onClose}; clicks inside the chat (opened via setActive → ChatSheet) bubble up and close the inbox too.
Consider extracting ChatSheet into a portal (createPortal to document.body) so its parent visual hierarchy is independent of which sheet opened it. This will also make the z-50 layering unambiguous.

Minor: send() in ChatSheet (line 584-599) optimistically clears text before awaiting the API; if the network fails the input is restored. Good. Just add e.stopPropagation() on the wrapper or use button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); send(); }}.

rca of the issue: ChatSheet root <div className='fixed inset-0 z-50 ...' data-testid='mkt-chat-sheet'> at SbMarketplacePage.js:602 lacks onClick stopPropagation. It is rendered inside DetailSheet (line 255, sibling of the inner content div) and also inside InboxSheet (line 528 wrapper). Both parent overlays use onClick={onClose} on the outermost div. Any click within ChatSheet (button or input — though native inputs synthesize their own events) bubbles up to that parent and triggers onClose, which unmounts DetailSheet/InboxSheet AND therefore ChatSheet (since ChatSheet is conditionally rendered as a child via chatOpen / setActive state). Effect: pressing the send paper-plane button unconditionally bounces the user back to the marketplace listings (or to behind-inbox state). Mitigation: add onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} to ChatSheet root div (one-line fix) or portal it out of these sheets.
